## Meaning

This monitor fired because the signal changed faster than the configured percentage relative to its own recent history. Speed of degradation, not absolute level.

Query:

```
pct_change(avg(last_15m),last_4h):sum:snmp.ifInErrors{__SCOPE__} by {device,interface}.as_rate() > 100
```

**Design note.** Rate-of-change, not absolute: a link with a stable low error count has a known cabling quirk; a link whose error rate doubles is failing now.

## Impact

Nothing is broken yet. A boundary will be crossed if nobody acts within the lead time this monitor provides.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-network-availability`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `diag-network` (diagnostic only) runs automatically on every alert.

Actions: `fetch_monitor`, `path_traceroute`, `device_interface_state`, `recent_config_changes`.

Attached to the alert automatically: traceroute, interface counters, config diffs in the last 24h.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `infrastructure-engineering` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `sre`.
3. Priority contract: P3 — next business day; this never pages.
